Rank 1. Two detached leaves laid flat on black cloth, sharp, one upper side and one pale lower side, both with the two deep middle sinuses and the wide crown-shaped tip of the look-for line. A small brown spot on one margin does not hide the shape.
Rank 2. One leaf held flat in a hand, sharp, full outline from petiole to tip, with deep middle sinuses that almost reach the midrib. A few insect holes; the shape is clear.

Rank 3. Leaves attached to a corky twig, sharp; the right leaf shows its full shape with the deep middle sinuses and the wide lobed tip. Mostly green with light late-season spotting. Adds an attached view next to the two detached picks.
